evidence: This track can be walked in either direction.
This description details a clockwise circuit of the track.
Start the circuit track from the Silverpeaks Scenic Reserve car park.
Continue to follow the wooden routed River Track signs to stay on the new track to complete the circuit and return to the Silverpeaks Scenic Reserve car park.

doubts: The car park start/end is left null: the only road-end features are where the Possum Hut Route meets Mountain Track Road, while the text puts the car park on the gravel road Double Hill Road / Semple Road / Steep Hill Road, so neither clearly matches. Jubilee Hut is reached by a 10 min spur from an intersection and the walk returns down the same spur to rejoin the circuit. The page says the circuit can be walked in either direction; the clockwise description is recorded. The Possum Hut side trip's departure point is not stated.
